title: Exercise Is the Medicine Nobody Prescribes

scenes.text: When everything falls apart, your head becomes the loudest place in the world. Regret. Shame. What-ifs. All night long.
Here's something nobody tells you. Your thoughts are loud. But sweat is quieter.
When you run until your lungs burn, there's no room for overthinking.
On your last rep, you're not thinking about her, or the money, or what people say. You're just there. Present. Fighting.
Exercise won't fix your problems. But it gives you the clarity to fix them yourself. A clear head makes better moves than a tired one.
Don't wait until you feel like it. You won't. Lace up anyway.
Thirty minutes. Every single day. No excuses. Walk, run, lift, whatever you've got.
Your mind is heavy. Let your body carry some of that weight. Then watch how much lighter everything gets.
